cases.question: 2026年8月按型号计算售出30天激活率，只统计观察满30天的设备，同时列出分子、分母和百分数。
cases.sql: SELECT "dp"."product_id" AS "product_id", COUNT(DISTINCT "bod"."device_id") AS "total_devices", COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN NOT "fa"."activation_date" IS NULL AND "fa"."activation_date" <= "fo"."paid_date" + INTERVAL '30' DAY THEN "bod"."device_id" END) AS "activated_devices", ROUND(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN NOT "fa"."activation_date" IS NULL AND "fa"."activation_date" <= "fo"."paid_date" + INTERVAL '30' DAY THEN "bod"."device_id" END) * 100.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT "bod"."device_id"), 2) AS "activation_rate_pct" FROM "fact_order" AS "fo" JOIN "fact_order_item" AS "foi" ON "fo"."order_id" = "foi"."order_id" JOIN "bridge_order_device" AS "bod" ON "foi"."item_id" = "bod"."item_id" JOIN "dim_device" AS "dd" ON "bod"."device_id" = "dd"."device_id" JOIN "dim_product" AS "dp" ON "dd"."product_id" = "dp"."product_id" LEFT JOIN "fact_device_activation" AS "fa" ON "bod"."device_id" = "fa"."device_id" WHERE "fo"."paid_date" >= CAST('2026-08-01' AS DATE) AND "fo"."paid_date" <= CAST('2026-08-31' AS DATE) AND "fo"."paid_date" <= CAST('2026-09-16' AS DATE) GROUP BY "dp"."product_id" ORDER BY "product_id" LIMIT 1001

assumptions: 售出日期以订单支付日期为准
激活窗口为支付日期起0至30天（含第30天）
设备去重：每台售出设备只计一次

cases.question: 2026年9月按型号统计售出30天售后设备率，同一设备多次报修只算一次，同时列出分子、分母和百分数。
cases.sql: WITH "sold_devices" AS (SELECT "dp"."product_id" AS "product_id", COUNT(DISTINCT "bod"."device_id") AS "total_devices" FROM "fact_order" AS "fo" JOIN "fact_order_item" AS "foi" ON "fo"."order_id" = "foi"."order_id" JOIN "bridge_order_device" AS "bod" ON "foi"."item_id" = "bod"."item_id" JOIN "dim_device" AS "dd" ON "bod"."device_id" = "dd"."device_id" JOIN "dim_product" AS "dp" ON "dd"."product_id" = "dp"."product_id" WHERE "fo"."paid_date" >= CAST('2026-09-01' AS DATE) AND "fo"."paid_date" < CAST('2026-10-01' AS DATE) AND "fo"."paid_date" <= CAST('2026-09-16' AS DATE) GROUP BY "dp"."product_id"), "service_devices" AS (SELECT "dp"."product_id" AS "product_id", COUNT(DISTINCT "bod"."device_id") AS "service_devices" FROM "fact_order" AS "fo" JOIN "fact_order_item" AS "foi" ON "fo"."order_id" = "foi"."order_id" JOIN "bridge_order_device" AS "bod" ON "foi"."item_id" = "bod"."item_id" JOIN "dim_device" AS "dd" ON "bod"."device_id" = "dd"."device_id" JOIN "dim_product" AS "dp" ON "dd"."product_id" = "dp"."product_id" JOIN "fact_service_ticket" AS "fst" ON "bod"."device_id" = "fst"."device_id" WHERE "fo"."paid_date" >= CAST('2026-09-01' AS DATE) AND "fo"."paid_date" < CAST('2026-10-01' AS DATE) AND "fo"."paid_date" <= CAST('2026-09-16' AS DATE) AND "fst"."created_date" >= "fo"."paid_date" AND "fst"."created_date" <= "fo"."paid_date" + INTERVAL '30' DAY GROUP BY "dp"."product_id") SELECT COALESCE("sd"."product_id", "sv"."product_id") AS "product_id", COALESCE("sv"."service_devices", 0) AS "service_devices", COALESCE("sd"."total_devices", 0) AS "total_devices", CASE WHEN COALESCE("sd"."total_devices", 0) = 0 THEN NULL ELSE ROUND(COALESCE("sv"."service_devices", 0) * 100.0 / "sd"."total_devices", 2) END AS "service_rate_percent" FROM "sold_devices" AS "sd" FULL OUTER JOIN "service_devices" AS "sv" ON "sd"."product_id" = "sv"."product_id" ORDER BY "product_id" LIMIT 1001

assumptions: 观察满30天售出设备，支付日起0至30天有工单的设备去重数/售出设备去重数；包含退款设备；不是工单数占比
每个读取fact_order的独立查询/CTE必须在WHERE添加paid_date <= DATE maturity_cutoff，防止纳入未满30天样本
